title: Implant Device Pricing by Payer Class and Campus — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Pricing methodology bulletin.** The implant lines (revenue code 0278) of an Outpatient Surgery Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), are priced by the implant pricing method, reading codes C1713 and C1762 by their charges and billed units:

| Payer class and campus | Codes C1713 and C1762 | Any other implant code |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim for services at Riverbend Surgery & Imaging Center - Grand Chute | Riverbend's device fee schedule: billed units of C1713 times 520.00 USD plus billed units of C1762 times 410.00 USD | expected allowed percentage of its charges |
| Commercial HMO Claim for services at a hospital campus (Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton or Riverbend Lakeshore Hospital - Neenah) | each code at the lesser of that schedule value and its charges | expected allowed percentage of its charges |
| otherwise | all implant charges at the expected allowed percentage | — |

The implant value is never above the billed charges of the implant lines.

**Hypothetical illustration.** C1713: 2 units charged 900.00; C1762: 1 unit charged 300.00. Schedule values: 1,040.00 and 410.00.
- Grand Chute, Commercial PPO Claim: 1,450.00, capped at the implant charges of 1,200.00.
- Neenah, Commercial HMO Claim: lesser of 1,040.00 and 900.00, plus lesser of 410.00 and 300.00 → 1,200.00.
